scope: /opt/bilive/autoslice/state/*.json, live day files only (*.pre-* backups excluded)
method: recursive walk of every JSON string leaf that is an absolute path with a media/subtitle extension (.mp4 .m4s .mp3 .wav .flac .m4a .mkv .ts .aac .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .ass .srt); os.path.exists() on each; classification by target tree plus a repo/lidousha candidate_id->surviving-stem index built from each day dir's *.record.json media_path
quiet_window: DISABLED flag present, zero free_session_autoslice/ffmpeg processes; scan is read-only and took no lock

class_legend.A_rename_drift: repo/lidousha deliverable that survives on disk under a different stem after hook/title surgery; state kept the pre-surgery filename. No data loss.
class_legend.A_repo_unresolved: repo/lidousha path with no surviving stem carrying that candidate_id in the day dir. Needs eyes.
class_legend.B_cleanup_deleted: out/ pipeline intermediate removed by the 2026-07-30 ENOSPC recovery cleanup or the 2026-08-10 capacity cleanup.
class_legend.C_foreign_workspace: path under /home/ivan/Project/vtuber-reproduce — that tree lives on WSL (hostname ROG-EYE), not on free. RESOLVED: all files present there, sha256-verified.
class_legend.A_retired_in_place: same filename retired into the day dir's _superseded/ or _quarantine/ subtree; moved, not deleted
